title: 2.2 Photoelectric effect: photons, work function and applications

q.Q1: Q1. A negatively charged zinc plate on an electroscope is lit with UV. Explain why the leaf falls.

q.Q6: Q6. Explain how a photocell can operate an automatic door at a supermarket.
